nom: Truly Scar Prevention Star Acne Patches

segments.sensitive: One reviewer with very sensitive skin reports the patch removed a stubborn whitehead overnight with no irritation, crediting warm water and cleansing beforehand for better results.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the patches work on active blemishes but can leave a small patch of dryness around the area afterward, and a related scrub/oil is described as helpful for dry skin elsewhere on the body.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin reports the patches work well, drawing out gunk or visibly shrinking blemishes overnight.

concerns.aging: One reviewer reports a tightening serum from the same brand shows slight early changes in skin appearance, but this is a single, very early-stage comment with no patch-specific claim.
concerns.dehydration: A couple of reviewers note mild dryness after using the star patches (one calls it a 'teeny tiny bit' fixable with moisturizer), while a related scrub and butter are described as leaving skin moisturized and soft; no reviewer reports the patches themselves as drying overall.
concerns.redness: Multiple reviewers report the patches reduce redness overnight or over a few days ('red marks gone in about 3 days', 'redness is gone' by morning), though a couple say the patch 'helped with redness' but did not draw out the blemish itself.
concerns.barrier: No reviewer specifically addresses barrier repair; the only related comment is incidental dryness left behind by the patch in one case.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers credit the patches with preventing or fading dark/scar spots after a blemish heals, but one reviewer reports the opposite — a patch left a visible dark spot despite the packaging claiming no dark spots.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority of reviewers report visible improvement in blemishes overnight or within a few days — shrinking, draining, or disappearing entirely; however, a notable minority (about a dozen) report no meaningful effect, saying the patches 'don't work,' fall off, or take much longer than competing brands.
concerns.oiliness: No reviewer discusses oiliness or oil control in relation to this product.

aspects.libelle: Draws out pus or gunk visibly
Star shape hard to apply, bends easily
Cute, discreet enough to wear out
Yellow tint visible and embarrassing on fair skin
Good value for quantity in pack

extraits.texte: let me just say I have very, very sensitive skin. and when I used this yesterday! OMG it literally took out the white head that I've been trying to get rid of for the last month !!!! I feel like why people aren't seeing results is because they either didn't wash their face before! or they didn't use warm water to open their pores. I recommend using warm water so you can open the pores on your face so the sticker can secure a better hold on the acne you trying to remove. 5 stars for this product I'll definitely get more !!

Alright so I have dry skin and am mildly acneic. Im one of those people that looks in the reviews to see if my skin type has tried the product before and gotten a decent result so if ur own if those people too, ur welcome im thinkin of you. Ok, so im always a lottle skeptical of overnight remedies but i had this pimple and it was HUGE. I was really trying hard to stick to my New Years resolution of not touching my face to pop a pimple so i got these patches. I slapped one on just before i went to bed and when i woke up in the morning, the huge red lump wasnt there anymore and i could literally see how much gunk was pulled out from it. It was literally visible on the sticker! Those things are always so interesting to me. But the point was that my face wasnt red or pimply in that spot anymore! The only thing i would say is that there was a tad bit of dry skin, and i mean a TEENY TINY bit of dry skin, but nothin a moisturizer cant fix!

I love these. They look adorable so I don't mind running errands with them on, but the effectiveness gets these a 5 star rating. I have very fair skin and scar very easily, it usually takes a long time for my zits to heal. These knock out red marks in about 3 days, I've found. Wear them as long as you possibly can. The difference between wearing them for 8 hours versus 12 hours is stark. They're not super sticky at first, but they WILL adhere to your skin and stay on all day (I literally wore them to a water park and they did not come off). If you plan on using these you cannot use any oils or heavy moisturizers. You HAVE to use something light with good absorption. I use la roche posay toleriane double repair, for example. Wait about 10 minutes before you let your face hit the pillow to give them time to settle on.

I decided to first give these blemish patches a try last year after reading the good reviews but without any big expectations. Well let's just say ever since I make sure to always have these on hand. They work awesome and no I'm not getting anything for this review, it's just honestly. I pop one on at night and sleep with it on. When I wake up either all the gunk has been brought to a "head" for very easy removal, or the bump is significantly smaller and less red. I am hooked on these. Plus they work to cover the blemish so people like me keep my hands off it and prevent me from making it worse. I also really loved the hemp version of these too, but they seemed to have stopped making them. I have yet to try the hearts, but I LOVE these star ones. If you are on the fence, give them a try.... you won't regret your purchase! I have combination skin, but they didn't give me that option to check.

extraits.titre: Go with Hero Mighty Patches instead
extraits.texte: I've purchased these several times before because they kinda worked (but not always), but yesterday I impulsively picked up the Hero Mighty Patches instead. I'm so glad I did, because a painful zit erupted on my neck later that day! Truly's stars are difficult to apply because of the shape. It's hard to peel them off the plastic and I usually end up bending the star's points. They're also so small that they're difficult to apply; and while they're a cute shape, they're hardly discreet. Meanwhile, the Mighty Patches cover more area and are much harder to notice. (They also have an invisible version that I haven't tried.) They're easy to apply, and I got much better results than I was able to with Truly's stars. I don't work for Hero Cosmetics, and up until yesterday, I thought I was pretty loyal to these stars. But I'm here to tell you as a friend, you want the Mighty Patch. Run, don't walk.

extraits.titre: I would probably not buy this item again.
extraits.texte: At first I was looking for the starface patches but they did not have them so I got these instead. I used a patch on one of my pimples and the next day it was still visible and left a star shaped mark on my cheek like it was imprinted. I also had one on my chin, and it left a dark spot when I took it off. The pack said "leaves no dark spots". This was a scam.

extraits.titre: The yellow color looks sick on fair skin!
extraits.texte: I primarily purchased because I was hoping to use them to camouflage smaller zits with a cute yellow star sticker. I found they stick extremely well and do seem to help somewhat in pulling gunk to the surface/fading the red out. But the yellow color looks so gross on the skin! One morning I forgot I had it on and went to the Starbucks drive thru- the barista said oh you have mustard on your face. I was kinda embarrassed but just told her it was an acne treatment lol. Now I know only to wear these at home alone and at night to sleep. They would be cuter if the yellow was brighter or the sticker less see through. As for treatment purposes the Zitsticka works way better, especially for those big painful blemishes, but it costs way more as well.
